18101916
REMARKS
In response to the Office Action mailed on April 16, 2024, Applicants respectfully request reconsideration and allowance of the rejected and newly submitted claims. The amendment to the claims does not constitute adding new matter to the specification. That is, any amendment to the claims is fully supported by the specification and figures.
Claims 1-21 are pending.
Claims 2-3 and 15-21 stand rejected.
In this amendment, claims 3, 15 are amended and claims 16-18 are cancelled.
Applicants encourage the Examiner to call the undersigned Attorney of record if the Examiner feels that a discussion of the pending claims would be helpful towards furthering prosecution of the present application towards allowance.
Formalities:
The Specification has been amended herein to correct the noted informalities. Also, claim 3 has been amended for minor grammatical inconsistencies.
Rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 112:
Claims 18-20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(a) or 35 U.S.C. 112 (pre-AIA), first paragraph, as failing to comply with the written description requirement. Claims 18-20 have been cancelled, therefore the rejection is deemed moot.
Rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 102:
Claims 15-17 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Choi, (KR 20180049576, provided by Applicant on 08/10/2023 IDS), hereinafter Choi ‘576.
Claim 15 has been amended to clarify that the optimal vehicle mobility performance is based on a mobility performance index, as disclosed at paragraph [0011] on pages 3-4, to further clarify. There is no showing, teaching or disclosure of a mobility performance index in Choi ‘576. Accordingly, claim 15 is therefore allowable.
Claims 1 and 4-14 have been indicated as allowable. The above remarks and amendments address the outstanding rejections of claims 2 and 3. The remaining claims are allowable by virtue of dependency. It is respectfully requested that all claims be passed to allowance.
CONCLUSION
Applicants respectfully submit that the pending claims are in condition for allowance. A Notice to this affect is respectfully requested. If the Examiner believes, after reviewing this Response, that the pending claims are not in condition for allowance, the Examiner is respectfully requested to call the Applicant(s) Representative at the number below.
Applicant(s) hereby petition(s) for any extension of time which is required to maintain the pendency of this case. If there is a fee occasioned by this response, including an extension fee, that is not covered by an enclosed check, please charge any deficiency to Deposit Account No. 60-2471.
If the enclosed papers or fees are considered incomplete, the Patent Office is respectfully requested to contact the undersigned Attorney at 978 764-7583, in Westborough, Massachusetts.
Respectfully submitted,
/Christopher J. Lutz/_______________
